I replied to Marcus in the thread in #north-team: the contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell.

- **Source:** Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20 that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again during the morning shift. Marcus is in that channel. The cause was one trailer logged as two 06:30 check-ins, once from the kiosk and once added by dispatch by hand.
- **Status:** Dana said at the time she was handling it. I found nothing newer, so I suggested Marcus check with her for the latest.
